The people of the country also worship Islam. There are more than 20 or 30 days of worship in the mosque. On the solstice, fasting, praying, and giving thanks.

In the fifth year of Yongle, the eunuch Zheng He and others were ordered to give the king an imperial edict to reward his generals. The king of the crown belt, the beautiful stone, Shangfu Tu, respects the elephant and the cow. There are five classes, one Hui, one south, one Zhe, one leather, one wood.

stories.title: The Tiger Play in the Markets of Bengal
stories.body:
The drumming is the order of the family. At the end of the meal, each family must work hard to buy wine, food, and money. The remaining 100 plays are all in existence, and the tiger is tied up with iron ropes in the market and people use it to untie the rope, sit on the tiger naked in the courtyard, and beat the tiger in anger.

The tiger fights and pounces on the servant tiger several times. Even if he throws his hand into the tiger's throat, the tiger will not be hurt. The play is still in the house.

The tiger must eat the tiger, work it with its meat, and the people will use money to cover the tiger play. In order to need money, there has been no money for the past twelve months. The red corn, wheat, sesame, beans, millet and rice produced by Runjue are harvested twice a year.

source.chapterTitle: The Tiger Play in the Markets of Bengal
